 Job Scan Home / GST / Big GST Changes from Nov 1! Centre Announces New Tax Rates, Exemptions and Reverse Charge Rules for Multiple Goods GST Law Report Big GST Changes from Nov 1! Centre Announces New Tax Rates, Exemptions and Reverse Charge Rules for Multiple Goods
 The Centre has announced GST changes covering tractor tyres, fertilisers, psyllium seeds and waste materials, along with revised registration and tax compliance rules.
 By  Kavi Priya · 28 Oct 2026, 1:26 pm IST 3′ read Save Get the day's tax rulings in your inbox 
 Email address Subscribe × Read the Order Subscribers only The Ministry of Finance (Department of Revenue) announced changes to Goods and Services Tax (GST) rates, exemptions, Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), registration and Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) provisions through a series of notifications dated October 27, 2026. 
 The amendments were issued on the recommendations of the GST Council and will take effect from November 1, 2026.
 GST Rate Changes 
 The Centre clarified that pre-packaged and labelled animal, vegetable and organic fertilisers, including seaweed-extract-based bio-stimulants registered under the Fertiliser (Control) Order, 1985, fall under the 5% GST category.
